keyPoints.en: Elections were introduced step by step: municipal (town) councils first, then states, then the whole Federation.
keyPoints.bm: Pilihan raya diperkenalkan secara berperingkat: majlis perbandaran dahulu, kemudian negeri, kemudian seluruh Persekutuan.

keyPoints.en: The first was the George Town municipal election, Penang (1 December 1951).
keyPoints.bm: Yang pertama ialah pilihan raya Majlis Perbandaran George Town, Pulau Pinang (1 Disember 1951).

keyPoints.en: In the Kuala Lumpur municipal election (February 1952) the UMNO–MCA pact won 9 of 12 seats.
keyPoints.bm: Dalam pilihan raya Majlis Perbandaran Kuala Lumpur (Februari 1952), pakatan UMNO–MCA memenangi 9 daripada 12 kerusi.

keyPoints.en: Local elections gave people and parties experience of democracy before the federal election.
keyPoints.bm: Pilihan raya tempatan memberi pengalaman demokrasi kepada rakyat dan parti sebelum pilihan raya persekutuan.

meaning.en: The process by which citizens choose their representatives by voting.
meaning.bm: Proses rakyat memilih wakil mereka melalui pengundian.

meaning.en: Government by the people through elected representatives.
meaning.bm: Pemerintahan oleh rakyat melalui wakil yang dipilih.

meaning.en: A party's written promises to voters.

points.en: 1951: George Town municipal election — the first election in the Federation.
points.bm: 1951: pilihan raya Majlis Perbandaran George Town — pilihan raya pertama di Persekutuan.

points.en: 1952: Kuala Lumpur municipal election — UMNO and MCA cooperated and won, the start of the Alliance.
points.bm: 1952: pilihan raya Majlis Perbandaran Kuala Lumpur — UMNO dan MCA bekerjasama dan menang, permulaan Perikatan.

points.en: 1952–1955: more town, local and state elections were held.
points.bm: 1952–1955: lebih banyak pilihan raya bandar, tempatan dan negeri diadakan.

points.en: 1955: the first federal general election.
points.bm: 1955: pilihan raya umum persekutuan yang pertama.

event.bm: Pilihan raya Majlis Perbandaran George Town.

event.en: Kuala Lumpur municipal election — UMNO–MCA win 9 of 12.
event.bm: Pilihan raya Majlis Perbandaran Kuala Lumpur — UMNO–MCA menang 9 daripada 12.

question.en: Why were local elections held before the federal election?
question.bm: Mengapakah pilihan raya tempatan diadakan sebelum pilihan raya persekutuan?

answer.en: To train voters, candidates and officials step by step, and to test whether parties of different races could work together.
answer.bm: Untuk melatih pengundi, calon dan pegawai secara berperingkat, serta menguji sama ada parti pelbagai kaum boleh bekerjasama.

keyPoints.en: Before the general election, the Alliance demanded that most seats in the Federal Legislative Council be elected.
keyPoints.bm: Sebelum pilihan raya umum, Perikatan menuntut supaya kebanyakan kerusi Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan dipilih.

keyPoints.en: The first general election was held on 27 July 1955 for 52 of the 98 seats.
keyPoints.bm: Pilihan raya umum pertama diadakan pada 27 Julai 1955 bagi 52 daripada 98 kerusi.

keyPoints.en: The Alliance won 51 seats; PAS won one (Krian, Perak).
keyPoints.bm: Perikatan memenangi 51 kerusi; PAS memenangi satu (Krian, Perak).

keyPoints.en: Early elections were also held in Sarawak (district councils, 1959) and Sabah (local councils, 1962).
keyPoints.bm: Pilihan raya awal turut diadakan di Sarawak (majlis daerah, 1959) dan Sabah (majlis tempatan, 1962).

meaning.en: Voting in private so no one knows your choice.
meaning.bm: Mengundi secara rahsia supaya tiada siapa tahu pilihan anda.
Orang yang bertanding dalam pilihan raya.

meaning.en: An area that elects one representative.

heading.en: a. Negotiations before the general election
heading.bm: a. Rundingan sebelum pilihan raya umum

points.en: The British first planned only a minority of elected seats; the Alliance wanted a clear elected majority.
points.bm: British pada mulanya merancang hanya sebilangan kecil kerusi dipilih; Perikatan mahukan majoriti kerusi dipilih yang jelas.

points.en: An Alliance delegation went to London (1954) and Alliance members withdrew from councils in protest.
points.bm: Rombongan Perikatan ke London (1954) dan ahli Perikatan menarik diri daripada majlis-majlis sebagai bantahan.

points.en: A compromise was reached: 52 of 98 seats elected, and the High Commissioner agreed to consult the majority party on some appointed seats.
points.bm: Kompromi dicapai: 52 daripada 98 kerusi dipilih, dan Pesuruhjaya Tinggi bersetuju berunding dengan parti majoriti tentang sebahagian kerusi lantikan.

heading.en: b. The 1955 Federal Legislative Council election
heading.bm: b. Proses Pilihan Raya Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan 1955

points.en: Parties: the Alliance, Parti Negara, PAS, the Labour Party and others; about 1.28 million registered voters.
points.bm: Parti: Perikatan, Parti Negara, PAS, Parti Buruh dan lain-lain; kira-kira 1.28 juta pengundi berdaftar.

points.en: The Alliance manifesto promised independence within four years.
points.bm: Manifesto Perikatan menjanjikan kemerdekaan dalam tempoh empat tahun.

points.en: Result: Alliance 51 seats, PAS 1; Tunku Abdul Rahman became Chief Minister.
points.bm: Keputusan: Perikatan 51 kerusi, PAS 1; Tunku Abdul Rahman menjadi Ketua Menteri.

heading.en: Early elections in Sarawak and Sabah
heading.bm: Pilihan raya awal di Sarawak dan Sabah

points.en: Sarawak: district council elections in 1959 began the path to state elections.
points.bm: Sarawak: pilihan raya majlis daerah pada 1959 memulakan jalan ke arah pilihan raya negeri.

points.en: Sabah: local council elections in 1962, before Malaysia was formed.
points.bm: Sabah: pilihan raya majlis tempatan pada 1962, sebelum Malaysia dibentuk.

alt.en: Poster of the winners of the 1955 general election, at the Proclamation of Independence Memorial, Melaka.
alt.bm: Poster pemenang pilihan raya umum 1955, di Memorial Pengisytiharan Kemerdekaan, Melaka.

caption.en: Poster of the winners of the 1955 general election, at the Proclamation of Independence Memorial, Melaka.
caption.bm: Poster pemenang pilihan raya umum 1955, di Memorial Pengisytiharan Kemerdekaan, Melaka.

question.en: Give TWO reasons the Alliance won the 1955 election.
question.bm: Berikan DUA sebab Perikatan menang pilihan raya 1955.

answer.en: (1) Cooperation of UMNO, MCA and MIC won votes from all races. (2) Its manifesto promised independence within four years, and Tunku gave strong leadership.
answer.bm: (1) Kerjasama UMNO, MCA dan MIC memperoleh undi semua kaum. (2) Manifestonya menjanjikan kemerdekaan dalam empat tahun, dan Tunku memberikan kepimpinan yang kukuh.

keyPoints.en: The Federal Legislative Council (Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan) made the Federation's laws.
keyPoints.bm: Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan membuat undang-undang Persekutuan.

keyPoints.en: 1948: all 75 members were appointed, with the High Commissioner as president.
keyPoints.bm: 1948: kesemua 75 ahli dilantik, dengan Pesuruhjaya Tinggi sebagai Yang Dipertua.

keyPoints.en: 1955: 98 members — 52 elected and 46 appointed — the first elected majority.
keyPoints.bm: 1955: 98 ahli — 52 dipilih dan 46 dilantik — majoriti dipilih yang pertama.

meaning.en: The law-making body before Parliament existed.
meaning.bm: Badan pembuat undang-undang sebelum Parlimen wujud.

meaning.en: When more than half of the members are chosen by voters.
meaning.bm: Apabila lebih separuh ahli dipilih oleh pengundi.

points.en: Set up under the Federation of Malaya Agreement 1948; members were appointed officials and community representatives.
points.bm: Ditubuhkan di bawah Perjanjian Persekutuan Tanah Melayu 1948; ahli terdiri daripada pegawai dan wakil masyarakat yang dilantik.

points.en: 52 members elected in the 1955 general election; the rest appointed.
points.bm: 52 ahli dipilih dalam pilihan raya umum 1955; selebihnya dilantik.

points.en: The Alliance, with 51 elected seats, formed the government.
points.bm: Perikatan, dengan 51 kerusi dipilih, membentuk kerajaan.

heading.bm: c. Kesan penubuhan Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan

points.en: Local people began to make laws for their own country.
points.bm: Penduduk tempatan mula menggubal undang-undang untuk negara sendiri.

points.en: It led to the first cabinet and gave Tunku a mandate to negotiate independence.
points.bm: Ia membawa kepada kabinet pertama dan memberi mandat kepada Tunku untuk merundingkan kemerdekaan.

question.en: How was the Federal Legislative Council of 1955 different from that of 1948?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan 1955 berbeza daripada 1948?

answer.en: In 1948 all members were appointed; in 1955, 52 of the 98 members were elected by the people, giving an elected majority.
answer.bm: Pada 1948 semua ahli dilantik; pada 1955, 52 daripada 98 ahli dipilih oleh rakyat, memberikan majoriti dipilih.

keyPoints.en: After the 1955 election the first cabinet was formed with Tunku Abdul Rahman as Chief Minister and Minister of Home Affairs.
keyPoints.bm: Selepas pilihan raya 1955 kabinet pertama dibentuk dengan Tunku Abdul Rahman sebagai Ketua Menteri dan Menteri Hal Ehwal Dalam Negeri.

keyPoints.en: Alliance ministers from UMNO, MCA and MIC worked alongside British officials, who still held some posts.
keyPoints.bm: Menteri Perikatan dari UMNO, MCA dan MIC bekerja bersama pegawai British, yang masih memegang beberapa jawatan.

keyPoints.en: The cabinet prepared the country for independence — including the London talks and the Razak Report (1956).
keyPoints.bm: Kabinet menyediakan negara ke arah kemerdekaan — termasuk rundingan London dan Penyata Razak (1956).

meaning.en: The group of ministers who lead the government.
Leader of the government before independence; Tunku held this post from 1955.
meaning.bm: Ketua kerajaan sebelum merdeka; Tunku memegang jawatan ini sejak 1955.

meaning.en: Replacing British officers with local officers in the civil service.
meaning.bm: Menggantikan pegawai British dengan pegawai tempatan dalam perkhidmatan awam.

points.en: Tunku Abdul Rahman — Chief Minister and Home Affairs.
points.bm: Tunku Abdul Rahman — Ketua Menteri dan Hal Ehwal Dalam Negeri.

points.en: Dato' Abdul Razak — Education (led the Razak Report); Dr Ismail — Natural Resources; Kolonel H.S. Lee — Transport; V.T. Sambanthan — Labour.
points.bm: Dato' Abdul Razak — Pelajaran (mengetuai Penyata Razak); Dr Ismail — Sumber Asli; Kolonel H.S. Lee — Pengangkutan; V.T. Sambanthan — Buruh.

points.en: Roles: led the independence talks in London (1956), started a national education policy and Malayanisation of the civil service.
points.bm: Peranan: memimpin rundingan kemerdekaan di London (1956), memulakan dasar pendidikan kebangsaan dan Malayanisasi perkhidmatan awam.

alt.bm: Tunku Abdul Rahman, Ketua Menteri sejak 1955 dan Perdana Menteri pertama.

question.en: Why was the first cabinet important?

answer.en: It was the first government led by elected local leaders, who gained experience, built a national education policy and negotiated independence.
answer.bm: Ia kerajaan pertama yang dipimpin pemimpin tempatan yang dipilih, yang memperoleh pengalaman, membina dasar pendidikan kebangsaan dan merundingkan kemerdekaan.
